caption: The drawing depicts two similar cylindrical stoneware crocks, both with light beige surfaces and darker brown interiors. Both crocks have rounded rims and protruding handles on each side. The larger crock, centered in the composition, features a blue painted decoration of a house with a pitched roof above a wavy, horizontal line and has the text "A.O. WHITTEMORE. HAVANA N.Y." inscribed above the blue house motif. The smaller crock, positioned in the upper left quadrant, is shown at a slight angle and also displays a partial blue painted motif on its side. The overall composition is set against a plain off-white background with a faint rectangular outline framing the objects. At the bottom left, the name "FRANCIS BORELLI" is written in print, and at the bottom right, there is a small measured diagram of the base of the main crock with inch and fractional measurements written alongside its sides.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
